title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
focus: Explain how the temperature T in a softmax turns logits into probabilities, q_i = exp(z_i/T) / sum_j exp(z_j/T). Let the learner edit a small vector of logits and change T. Show the scaled logits, the probabilities and how spread out they are. Compare T = 1 with a high and a low temperature. Check that the probabilities sum to one, that equal logits give a uniform distribution for every T, and that the order of the probabilities matches the order of the logits.
